slides.title: Welcome to Version 1.28.0
slides.description: This release introduces a modern, redesigned Login Page and enhances communication with real-time Comet Chat features including group chat, polls, and file sharing. Participant creation is improved with support for adding unlimited contacts. Bulk upload capabilities for both staff and facilities significantly speed up large data imports.

slides.title: Login Page
slides.description: Introduced a newly designed Login Page featuring an improved and modern UI. Enhanced user experience with a cleaner layout, updated styling, and smoother interaction flow.

slides.title: Comet Chat Integration
slides.description: Enabled real-time one-to-one and group messaging with added support for polls and file sharing. This enhancement allows users to collaborate and communicate more efficiently within the platform.

slides.title: Participant
slides.description: Users can now add an unlimited number of contacts while creating a participant. This improvement provides greater flexibility and simplifies data entry.

slides.title: Staff Bulk Upload
slides.description: Introduced bulk upload functionality allowing users to add multiple staff records at once. This significantly speeds up data entry and reduces manual effort.

slides.title: Facility Bulk Upload
slides.description: Enabled bulk upload for facilities, making it easier to import large sets of facility data efficiently and accurately.
